call_points.text: Store opening plan remains in line with the guidance given earlier; no new number was given on the call.
KFC dine-in salience target is 59-60%, not the 65% an analyst asked about.
Biryani By Kilo is targeted to become a ₹1,000 Cr brand in the next few years.
The dine-in shift needs no extra capex; stores have excess capacity and future formats stay unchanged.
Technology buildout is a core in-house team plus outsourced build to Cognizant, targeted before the merger.
July trends are positive, but Q2 has a Shravan timing drag versus last year.
LPG prices rose sharply and minimum wages and increments added cost; KFC and Pizza Hut took slight price increases.
Promoters are described as bullish and funding is not an issue; no debt or balance-sheet figures were discussed.
Management says a very bullish SSSG view needs a stable macro, which it does not see given oil, rupee and LPG pressure.
Sapphire merger is on track for FY27-end; NSE and BSE approvals came in June and IT systems are largely similar.
New COO, CTO and CMO are in place; KFC's global Kwench beverages, sauces and boneless initiatives will come to India.
KFC delivered positive SSSG of 4.9%, its strongest performance in 14 quarters.
KFC delivered its strongest performance in 14 quarters with +4.9% SSSG and ~15% YoY growth.
Proposed merger with Sapphire Foods creates one of the largest QSR platforms globally.

operating_notes.text: Devyani International ended FY26 with a global network of 2,256 stores after adding 217 net new stores.
Devyani International reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹1,437 Cr, up 18.5% YoY.
Ended FY26 with a global network of 2,256 stores after adding 217 net new stores.
KFC delivery share rose from under 10% pre-COVID to about 45-46% today, which management says is eating into dine-in sales.
The organised and unorganised biryani market is estimated at ₹30,000-40,000 Cr, with the biggest brand at about ₹300-350 Cr.
Own brands (Vaango and Biryani By Kilo) posted ₹98 Cr revenue with 10.2% brand contribution margin and 218 stores, including 23 BBK Express stores.
